subject: CTO + Sponsor Recap: Pilot scope, procurement path, and outstanding risks
messages:
From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@novacorp.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Bell <tom.bell@novacorp.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up after today's CTO call

Thanks Mateo — helpful conversation today. Confirming the top priorities we discussed for NovaCorp:

- Reduce inference latency to < 200ms p95 for chat assistant (current: ~450ms)
- Cut per-request cost by ~30% in peak hours
- Maintain auditability and data residency for PHI-sensitive flows (SOC2 + region-specific retention)

Next steps on our side: I'll get security team to run through the evidence pack and follow up with the SOC2 alignment questions by next Wednesday. Procurement will need an expected SOW + T-shirt pricing. Can you send a one-page pilot scope and the typical procurement checklist you use for enterprise pilots?

Thanks,
Sarah
Director of Platform Engineering
NovaCorp
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@novacorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Sep 2026 17:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up after today's CTO call

Sarah — great to connect. Short recap + attachments attached.

Recap of pain & goals (as I heard them):
1) Latency SLO: p95 < 200ms for 512-token chat flows; occasional spikes tolerated during batch jobs
2) Cost target: 30% reduction on peak gen spend through batching/caching + model selection
3) Compliance: Data residency EU/US split, audit logs retention 7 years for PHI flows

What Redwood will deliver for pilot (one-page summary attached):
- Dedicated pilot capacity: 2x A100-equivalent nodes for 6 weeks
- Integration: VPC peering, KMS-based key management, minimal changes to your client SDK
- Success criteria: verified p95 latency under load, per-token cost delta measured vs baseline, SOC2 evidence checklist signoff

Attached: novacorp-security-evidence-summary.pdf (security pack), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (pilot milestones + acceptance criteria), pilot-scope-onepager.pdf

Open items / risks:
- Procurement: NovaCorp requires PO net-60 and a data processing addendum signed by legal — Marissa will lead contracting
- Security: engineering wants penetration test window defined (we recommend a read-only snapshot access window)
- Ops: monitoring hooks need a short namespace mapping (Grace to provide mapping doc)

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Marissa to send SOW + commercial T&Cs draft by EOD Monday
2) Grace to schedule a 60-min security review with Nova's security team (target Tue 2026-09-08)
3) Sarah to provide baseline perf traces for two representative flows (chat + batch summarize)

If that aligns, we'll lock in the pilot start by Sept 21.

Cheers,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attach: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (see tab "MVP and SLAs")
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@novacorp.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Sep 2026 08:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up after today's CTO call

Sarah — looping in our contracting lead. Per Mateo's note, here's the plan from contracting/procurement side and what we'll need from NovaCorp to keep the timeline:

- I'll send a draft SOW + T&Cs by end of day Monday (2026-09-07). That will include the pilot term (6 weeks), cancellation terms, and a standard Redwood DPA.
- Commercial asks: PO net-30 is Redwood standard; we can support net-60 by case (need exec sponsor approval at Redwood). Can you confirm internal approver for PO commits?
- Legal redlines: please flag any sections you know will need redlines (data retention, indemnity, SLA credits). We'll highlight items that typically come up.

Marissa Cole
Head of Contracts | Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 07 Sep 2026 09:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up after today's CTO call

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the quick follow. Approver for PO is Tom Bell (VP Finance) — cc'd him here.

Tom — quick ask: would net-60 be a showstopper for NovaCorp? We expect to run a six-week pilot and then move to procurement. If net-60 requires further sign-off on your side, please let us know the quickest path.

Sarah
From: Tom Bell <tom.bell@novacorp.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@novacorp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up after today's CTO call

Sarah/Marissa — thanks for the context. Net-60 is acceptable for the pilot with the following conditions:
- We need a three-line description of costs up front for internal approvals (monthly T&M estimate + potential overage caps)
- Must include a signed DPA (or confirmation of Redwood's standard DPA is acceptable)
- Pilot PO to be accompanied by a purchase memo from Sarah's org

Marissa — if you can send an itemized pilot SOW and the DPA stub, we'll route on our side and aim to get PO issued within 10 business days of receiving docs.

Tom Bell
VP Finance
NovaCorp
